$comment: Contrast build gate manifest. Copy to accessibility/contrast.config.json in the generated site and fill in every real pairing and state. cssFiles auto-loads the site's CSS custom properties so token edits are checked against the live Style Guide; `tokens` is for inline overrides only. fg/bg accept a literal (#hex, rgb(), hsl(), named) or var(--token). Flags: large=true for >=18pt / >=14pt bold, ui=true for non-text (borders, icons, focus rings).

coverage.$comment: Used by contrast-coverage.mjs (the companion linter) to find color tokens used in the UI that no pairing above checks. sources = dirs/files to scan; ignoreTokens = colors intentionally left unpaired; failOnUncovered = true turns warnings into a build failure (default warns only).
